column1: # 忌部神社 — settled 2026-08-04 after three passes, worth recording so it is not reopened.
# The 分霊 page says "comes from the main inbe lineage. Not gosho shrine", refusing 五所神社
# without naming a replacement. Emma named Q705547 安房神社, then Q11490722 (this row's own
# subject) when the migration direction was raised, then settled on 天太玉命神社: the shrine
# of 天太玉命, ancestral kami of the 忌部氏, which is ALREADY the P612 of 安房神社 from the
# article read. So the two Inbe shrines are siblings under one ancestor rather than one of
# them being the other's parent — which is what "the main inbe lineage" describes, and it
# does not require deciding whether Awa or Chiba came first.
忌部神社
column4: comes from the main inbe lineage. Not gosho shrine — Emma 2026-08-04: 天太玉命神社, the same ancestor 安房神社 points at
